RULE.description:
The rule that produced the covariance. In a CCSDS covariance block,
Operator keeps the operator's COV_BASIS, ScaledFit is DETERMINED, and
SourceModel, PooledModel and EmpiricalHistoryShrunk are EMPIRICAL with
MODEL_ID as COV_BASIS_ID.

MODEL_ID.description:
Identifier of the error model (SourceModel, PooledModel) or of the
measured realism factor (ScaledFit) the covariance came from. Empty for
Operator. For EmpiricalHistoryShrunk, identifies the population prior;
EVIDENCE identifies the history estimator and its configuration.

REGIME.description: Orbit regime of the cell, as the model names it.

AGE_DAYS.description:
Age of the element set at the covariance's epoch, in days. NaN when the
covariance is not an element set's.

HORIZON_DAYS.description:
Prediction horizon of the cell, in days: the element-set age its
statistics were measured at. NaN when no cell applies.

MEASURED_LINEAGE.description:
Lineage of the reference data the cell was measured on (a PVN LINEAGE).
The test speaks for a covariance whose source has this lineage; for any
other lineage the numbers are the cell's, and CALIBRATION is Uncalibrated.

TEST_WINDOW.description:
Window of the held-out reference states the test used: an ISO 8601 UTC
interval, start/end.

MEAN_D2_OVER_3.description: Mean of d2/3 over the held-out samples. NaN when not measured.

COVERAGE_95.description:
Share of the held-out samples inside the 95 % region, 0 to 1. NaN when
not measured.

SAMPLES.description: Number of held-out samples the test used.

OBJECTS.description: Number of distinct objects the samples came from.

SCALE_FACTOR.description:
Factor the covariance was multiplied by to make it realistic. NaN when
none was applied.

CALIBRATION.description:
The verdict. Calibrated when MEAN_D2_OVER_3 lies in [0.8, 1.25] and
COVERAGE_95 in [0.93, 0.97], from at least 30 samples of at least 3
objects of MEASURED_LINEAGE; Uncalibrated otherwise, including a cell
never measured.

EVIDENCE.description: Identifier of the report or record that holds the test.

HISTORY_SAMPLES.description:
Number of retained older/newer element-set residual pairs from this
object in the age bin containing AGE_DAYS, after rejection/clipping.
Zero means no retained pairs; never the held-out test count SAMPLES.

HISTORY_SETS.description:
Number of distinct older element sets contributing HISTORY_SAMPLES.
Zero means none; never the distinct calibration-object count OBJECTS.

HISTORY_WINDOW.description:
ISO 8601 UTC start/end interval spanning the element-set epochs used
in the object's history fit. Empty when no history was used. This is
training support, not TEST_WINDOW or the element-set age AGE_DAYS.

SHRINKAGE_WEIGHT.description:
Dimensionless population-prior fraction alpha in the covariance blend
P = (1-alpha) H + alpha P_prior, where H is the history error second
moment and P_prior includes the population model's realism scaling.
Range [0,1]: 0 is all history, 1 is all prior; NaN when not applicable
or unknown. For interpolation across bins, report the correspondingly
interpolated alpha. EVIDENCE must identify the estimator/configuration,
retained-count bin, participating bins and their weights so the blend
can be reconstructed; the scalar alone does not describe that mixture.
This is not SCALE_FACTOR, which multiplies a covariance. History-only
evidence leaves CALIBRATION Uncalibrated and test statistics unmeasured.

SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

ERMRegime.description:
One orbit regime: a set falls in the first regime whose half-open ranges
hold its mean altitude (from un-Kozai'd SGP4 mean motion, WGS-72) and
eccentricity.

ERMAgeBin.description:
A prediction-age bin, days, half-open (the last bin includes its upper
edge).

ERMClipCentre.description: Robust clipping centre and scale of one stratum.

CENTRE_KM.description: Centre of the R, T, N position errors, km (3 values).

SCALE_KM.description: Robust scale of the R, T, N position errors, km (3 values).

K.description:
Errors further than K robust scales from the centre are clipped; 0 = no
clipping.

ERMStrataSettings.description:
The strata of a model and how samples are taken. Empty REGIMES and
AGE_BINS mean the producer's defaults.

REFERENCE_STEP_S.description: Reference states are thinned to this step, s.

ERMGate.description: Coverage gate of a realism test.

TOLERANCE.description: Allowed departure of each coverage fraction from nominal.

NOMINAL.description:
Nominal 1, 2, 3 sigma coverage of chi-square with 3 degrees of freedom
(3 values).

ERMCounts.description: Counters of a run. A counter a run does not keep is 0.

RULE_COUNTS.description: Products whose covariance came from each rule, 1 to 4 (4 values).

ERMMoments.description: First and second moments of error vectors.

ERMHistogramBin.description:
One histogram bin: |x| in 20 bins per decade from 1e-9 to 1e5, signed bin
number (0 = |x| < 1e-9, +-k for k = 1..280).

ERMCoverageTally.description: Running realism test of one stratum.

INSIDE.description: Samples inside the 1, 2, 3 sigma regions (3 values).

OBJECTS.description: NORAD numbers of the objects sampled.

COVERAGE.description: Realism tally (when a model is tested).

ERMAccumulator.description: Errors accumulated over batches; a later batch adds to it as its prior.

COVERAGE_MODEL.description:
The model tested against, e.g. "reference", "reference+scaled"; empty =
none.

MEAN.description: Mean, 6 values; empty when N is 0.

ERMCoverage.description: Result of a realism test of one stratum.

MEAN_D2.description: Mean d2 (3 for a realistic covariance); NaN when N is 0.

INSIDE.description: Fractions inside the 1, 2, 3 sigma regions (3 values).

PIT_MAX_CDF_GAP.description: Largest gap of the PIT cumulative distribution from uniform.

ERMStratumScale.description: Per-axis scale applied to a stratum's position covariance.

FACTORS.description: s_R, s_T, s_N (covariance scaled by s_a s_b), 3 values.

COVARIANCE.description: Sample covariance, Lower21; empty when N < 2.

QUANTILES.description:
Quantiles, per component at the model's QUANTILE_PROBABILITIES,
component-major (6 x 7 values).

CALIBRATION.description: Whether the stratum's covariance passed its realism test.

CALIBRATION_REFERENCE.description: Identifier of the realism evidence; empty unless calibrated.

ERMRealismCell.description: A realism cell: a regime and age tested at a horizon.

DECISION.description:
The test's decision as worded, e.g. "REALISTIC",
"NOT REALISTIC (overconfident)".

REALISM.description:
REGIME, HORIZON_DAYS, MEAN_D2_OVER_3, COVERAGE_95, SAMPLES, OBJECTS,
CALIBRATION of the cell.

ERMStratumFactor.description: A factor applied to one stratum (or a status for it).

STATUS.description: Status string of the stratum, e.g. "CALIBRATED"; empty = none.

ERMHorizonFactor.description: A factor by regime and horizon.

FACTOR.description: Variance factor; NaN when AXES_FACTORS is given.

AXES_FACTORS.description: Per-axis factors R, T, N (3 values); empty when FACTOR is given.

ERMProcessNoise.description: Process noise of a numerical propagation: white acceleration.

ERMNoiseFit.description: How a process noise was fitted.

WINDOW_START.description: Window of the samples, ISO 8601 UTC.

CALIBRATED_STRATA_MAXIMUM_LIKELIHOOD.description: Strata calibrated with the ML densities and with P0 alone.

SELECTED.description: Which was selected: "P0 alone" or "maximum likelihood".

ERMPropagatorRegime.description: Initial covariance and process noise of one regime.

N.description: Samples and those kept after clipping.

P0.description:
Covariance at the element-set epoch, Lower21 RTN (km, km/s); empty =
none.

ERMProvenanceFile.description: A file a model was derived from.

TRUTH_WINDOW.description: Window of the truth model, ISO 8601 interval; empty = not stated.

ID.description: Model identifier (e.g. a calibration version); empty = none.

CALIBRATION_VERSION.description: Version of the calibration the model freezes; empty = none.

CANDIDATE.description: Name of the candidate or variant, e.g. "S3-KC".

BASIS_TEXT.description: How the statistics were formed, human-readable.

PROPAGATOR.description:
Propagator the predictions came from, e.g. "SGP4 (Vallado 2020,
WGS-72, opsmode i)".

HORIZONS_DAYS.description: Horizons of the realism cells, days.

QUANTILE_PROBABILITIES.description: Probabilities of the stratum quantiles (7 values).

COVERAGE_MODEL.description: Model the realism was tested against; empty = none.

STRATUM_FACTORS.description: ElementSetModel: factors and statuses by stratum.

MINIMUM_BIN_SAMPLES.description: ElementSetModel: strata with fewer samples are not used.

EPOCH_WINDOW_START.description: PropagatorCovariance: window of the epoch fit, ISO 8601.

SOURCES.description: Sources (lineages) the model applies to; empty = any.

POOLED.description: True for a model pooled over all sources.

PROVENANCE_REPOSITORY.description: Repository, commit and files the model was derived from.

LABEL.description: Free label, e.g. the model and calibration paths.

MINIMUM_SAMPLES.description: Strata with fewer clipped reference samples stay unscaled.

ERMScreeningCase.description: A screening case: two objects' position errors and covariances.

ERROR1_KM.description: RTN position errors, km (3 values each).

ERMScreeningRow.description: Rule scores at one miss distance.

COLLISION.description: True when the miss is within the hard-body radius.

ERMScreeningDefinitions.description: Definitions of the terms of a screening report (human-readable).

ERMScreeningReport.description: Scores of probabilistic, bounded-set and possibility screening rules.

EPOCH_TOLERANCE_S.description:
Age 0 uses the first reference epoch at or after the set epoch within
this, s.

TARGET_TOLERANCE_S.description: Other ages use the nearest reference epoch within this, s.

TRUTH.description: Reference state, GCRF, km and km/s (6 values).

ERMArc.description: One propagation arc from an element set.

EPOCH.description: Element-set epoch, as the record gives it.

COVARIANCE.description: Initial covariance, 6x6 row-major GCRF, SI (36 values); empty = none.

COVARIANCE_NOTE.description: How the covariance and the truth were formed, human-readable.

ERMPredictionSample.description: A propagated state at one arc target.

STATE.description: State, GCRF, m and m/s (6 values); empty = no prediction.

P0_POSITION.description:
Position covariance from P0 alone, m**2, xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz (6
values); empty = none.

NOISE_RESPONSES.description:
Unit-density process-noise responses for R, T, N, each in the order of
P0_POSITION (3 x 6 values); empty = none.

ERMArcPrediction.description: Predictions of one arc, aligned with its targets.

ERMCoverageOptions.description: Settings of a propagator covariance coverage run.

WINDOW_START.description: Targets whose epoch is in [start, stop), ISO 8601.

CLIP_K.description: Robust clip multiple of the epoch fit.

DISCRETIZATION_S.description: Discretization of the noise fit, s.

ERMPropagatorCoverageStratum.description: Coverage of one stratum of a propagator covariance.

RMS_ERROR_RTN_KM.description: RMS errors and sigmas, km (3 values each).

ERMPropagatorCoverageReport.description: Coverage test of a propagator covariance.

ERMCommonEpochTarget.description: A request for differences at a common epoch.

SETS.description: Element-set epochs to propagate there (matched within 1 s).

AFTER_S.description: Use the first reference epoch within this after EPOCH, s; 0 = exact.

ERMSetDifference.description: One element set's difference from the origin.

RTN.description: Prediction minus origin in the origin's RTN axes (6 values).

MISSING.description: Why there are no differences; empty otherwise.

STATE.description: Origin state, GCRF, km and km/s (6 values).

ERMMapRequest.description: A covariance to map through a state transition.

FROM_EPOCH.description: Covariance epoch; empty = the set epoch.

AXES_SET.description: Set whose state at FROM_EPOCH defines the input axes; empty = the anchor.

ERMLambertArc.description: The Lambert arc of a mapping.

ERMMappedCovariance.description: A mapped covariance at one target.

STM.description: STM, 6x6 row-major (TEME, km, km/s); empty unless requested.

ERMStateSample.description: A sampled state with a covariance.

ERMPairSide.description: One side of a predicted-versus-truth pair.

POSITION_M.description: Position, m, and velocity, m/s, inertial (3 values each).

COVARIANCE.description: Covariance: Lower6, 3x3 (9), Lower21 or 6x6 (36), SI; empty = none.

COVARIANCE_TERMS.description: Summed covariance terms, instead of COVARIANCE.

SAMPLES.description: Samples to interpolate at EPOCH (sampled form).

ERMStatePair.description: A predicted state and a truth state.

MISSING.description: Why the pair could not be evaluated; empty otherwise.

ERROR_RTN_M.description: Error (predicted minus truth), RTN, m and m/s (3 values each).

INTERPOLATION_DEGREE.description:
Interpolation of the predicted side: degree, first sample index,
samples; 0 = not interpolated.

PREDICTED_RTN.description: Position covariances, Lower6, RTN, m**2; TRUTH_RTN empty = none.

ERMCalibrationSample.description: An error with its predicted covariance, for fitting calibration factors.

FACTOR.description: Variance factor; NaN when per axis.

AXES_FACTORS.description: Per-axis variance factors (3 values); empty when scalar.

ERMCalibration.description: Calibration factor fit: samples, settings and result.

ERMCalibrationObject.description: An object to give a calibrated covariance.

SET_NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Element set placing it in a regime: NORAD number and epoch.

POSITION_M.description: Inertial state, m and m/s (3 values each); empty = none.

AGE_DAYS.description: Element-set age, days (set models); NaN = none.

HORIZON_DAYS.description: Prediction horizon, days (factor models); NaN = none.

COVARIANCE.description: Covariance to scale: 6, 9, 21 or 36 values, SI.

AGE_INDEX.description: Cell: age index (-1 outside) or horizon range.

COVARIANCE_INERTIAL.description: 6x6 row-major inertial, SI; empty unless a state was given.

ERMCalibratedCovariances.description: Calibrated covariances: the objects and the result.

ERMDensitySegment.description: A segment of the density forecast at one lead day.

ERMConsiderEpoch.description: Sensitivity of one epoch to the density error.

SENSITIVITY.description: dx/d ln B from the start, SI (6 values); empty when STM and S are given.

STM.description: STM from the start (36 values) and dx/dB (6 values).

BASE.description: Base covariance, 21 or 36 values, SI; empty = none.

ERMConsiderCovariance.description: A density-forecast consider covariance at one epoch.

WEIGHTS.description: Weight of each lead day (K values).

TOTAL.description: BASE plus COVARIANCE; empty when no base.

ERMConsiderCovariances.description: Density-forecast consider covariance: request and result.

LEAD_COVARIANCE.description: Covariance of the daily ln-density error by lead day, K x K row-major.

START_STM.description: STM (36) and dx/dB (6) at the start; empty = none.

ERMStmSample.description: An STM sample of a propagation.

STM.description: Row-major n x n, 6 <= n <= 36 (top-left 6x6 used).

ERMNoiseResponse.description: Unit process-noise responses at one target.

RESPONSES.description: 6x6 row-major per unit density on R, T, N (3 x 36 values).

ERMFitSettings.description:
Settings of a fit of element sets to an ephemeris (shared, or for one
object when NORAD_CAT_ID is set).

STEP_S.description: Thin the ephemeris to this step, s; 0 = every state.

BSTAR.description: Fixed B*, 1/earth radii; NaN = the a priori set's, else 0.

BSTAR_FROM_APRIORI.description: Take B* from the a priori set.

REJECT_SIGMA.description: Reject residuals beyond this many sigma; 0 = none.

SCALE_COVARIANCE.description:
Scale the fit covariance by the residual variance (default true unless
WEIGHTING is EphemerisCovariance).

HAS_SCALE_COVARIANCE.description: True when SCALE_COVARIANCE carries a value; false means the default.

ERMFitOptions.description: Fit settings: shared by every object, and per object.

SHARED.description: Settings for every object without its own entry in FITS.

FITS.description:
Per-object overrides (NORAD_CAT_ID set); empty = fit every object of
the ephemeris with SHARED.

LABEL.description: Window label and bounds (when for a window).

HALF_WIDTH_S.description: Half-width of the stage's span, s; NaN = whole span.

CLASSICAL.description: Classical-element covariance, lower 6x6 or 7x7; empty = none.

CARTESIAN_RSW.description: Cartesian RSW covariance, Lower21 (km, km/s); empty = none.

ERMClosureTest.description: The half-split closure test of a fit.

ERMElementFit.description: The fit of one object. The fitted element set is the companion $OMM.

ERROR.description: Why the fit failed; empty on success.

EQUINOCTIAL.description: n (rad/min), af, ag, chi, psi, lambda, B* (7 values).

ERMElementFits.description: Element-set fits or residuals against an ephemeris.

MODEL.description: Model, e.g. "SGP4 (Vallado 2020), WGS-72, opsmode i; TEME".

ERMRealismFactor.description: A measured realism factor for a source's fit class.

REALISM.description:
SCALE_FACTOR, MEAN_D2_OVER_3, COVERAGE_95, SAMPLES, OBJECTS, EVIDENCE,
TEST_WINDOW.

ERMAttachRecipe.description: Recipe for attaching covariances to one source's products.

SOURCE.description:
The source (SOURCE_ID, SOURCE_KIND, LINEAGE, ORIGINATOR, PROVIDER_ID,
LICENSE_CLASS, LICENSE_ID) and the producer.

CREATED.description: Creation date written to the products, ISO 8601.

LATEST_ONLY.description: Only the newest set of each object.

ERMRuleNote.description: Why an earlier rule did not apply.

ERMRowLabel.description: The covariance of one row of a product.

REALISM.description: The label (rule, model, regime, age, horizon, verdict numbers).

VERDICT.description: The cell's decision or "formal covariance, before scaling".

ERMAttachedObject.description: One object's product and the covariance it got.

ERMRefusedRecord.description: A record that could not be used.

ERMAttachReport.description: Report of attaching covariances (or attributing maneuvers).

ERM.description: Orbit Error Model - exactly one arm is set.
